text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Company research analyst Sheryl Skolnick raised her rating on Novacare Inc from a market performer to a long-term attractive rating.
-- Notes 1997E EPS of $0.58 may significantly understate the growth potential at the new Novacare.
-- Notes estimate does not reflect the full extent of potential acquisitions nor, the likelihood of continued strong demand in each of its rehab segments.

-- Novacare is the largest provider of contract medical rehab therapy and orthotic and prosthetic patient care services in the United States. The company is also the nation's largest operator of outpatient physical therapy clinics.
